posts.zh:
dsh-native-memory 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于 DSH 原生接缝的按工作区记忆：事实与有界常驻档案落在 storage-domain 的 JSON 单元上，写入经人工审批并带 `(sessionId, seq)` 引证，确定性召回 + session-query 全文检索历史会话——无外部服务器、无自建 SQLite。

posts.en:
dsh-native-memory is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Native per-workspace memory on the harness's own seams: facts and a bounded always-on profile on the storage-domain JSON unit, approval-gated writes with `(sessionId, seq)` citations, deterministic recall plus session-query FTS over past sessions — no external server, no custom SQLite.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-94eae68d574420a5f7d8.html
